# PSIPRED V4.1 weights

This directory contains only the original PSIPRED V4.1 neural-network
weights used by the Rust implementation in
`software/rust/protstruct_psipred/`.

- `data/weights.dat`, `weights.dat2`, `weights.dat3`: first-level averaged
  network weights.
- `data/weights_p2.dat`: PSIPASS2 second-level network weights.
- `LICENSE`: PSIPRED GPLv3 license.
- `VERSION`: PSIPRED release version (4.1).

No C/C++ source code or C executables are included. PSIPRED is
Copyright (C) David T. Jones and contributors, distributed under GPLv3.
